title: Hardcoded production database password stored as a module-level constant
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L10 declares DATABASE_PASSWORD as a plain string literal at module level; anyone with read access to the source code has the production database credential, enabling direct database access outside the application.

title: yaml.load() without SafeLoader allows arbitrary Python object instantiation
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L17 calls yaml.load(handle.read()) with no Loader argument; PyYAML's default loader executes arbitrary Python constructors embedded in the YAML document, enabling remote code execution if the file contents are attacker-controlled. Reclassified from CWE-20 to CWE-502 (deserialization).
owaspCategory: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures

title: TLS certificate validation disabled in fetch_project() request
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L24 sets verify=False in the requests.get() call at L21-25; this disables TLS certificate verification for the outbound API call, allowing a man-in-the-middle to intercept the Bearer token and response data.

title: HTTP request in fetch_project() has no timeout — resource exhaustion risk
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L21-25 calls requests.get() without a timeout parameter; a slow or non-responding server causes the calling thread to block indefinitely, enabling denial of service if many concurrent requests are outstanding.

title: Command injection via os.system() with string-formatted project_id and destination
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L30-31 builds a shell command by interpolating project_id and destination into a format string passed to os.system(); shell metacharacters in either parameter allow execution of arbitrary commands as the portal process.

title: Path traversal in render_template() via caller-supplied template_path
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L35 opens template_path without normalizing or rejecting path traversal sequences; if template_path is attacker-controlled, '../' components can read files outside the intended templates directory.

title: subprocess.run() with caller-supplied argv list allows arbitrary process execution
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/api.py:L43 passes argv directly to subprocess.run() without restricting the executable; a caller that controls argv[0] can execute any program accessible to the portal process.
